chunks.arabic_text: ٢٩٤٦ - وَرَوَى عَلِيُّ بْنُ رِئَابٍ عَنْ مِسْمَعِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ:

translations.en: Hadith 2946 — And ʿAlī ibn Riʾāb narrated from Mismaʿ ibn ʿAbd al-Malik, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:

chunks.arabic_text: فِي الرَّجُلِ يَعْتَمِرُ عُمْرَةً مُفْرَدَةً ثُمَّ يَطُوفُ بِالْبَيْتِ طَوَافَ الْفَرِيضَةِ ثُمَّ يَغْشَى امْرَأَتَهُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَسْعَى بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ

translations.en: Regarding a man who performs an independent ʿUmrah, then performs the obligatory tawaf of the House, then has relations with his wife before he performs saʿy between al-Safa and al-Marwah.

chunks.arabic_text: قَالَ «قَدْ أَفْسَدَ عُمْرَتَهُ وَعَلَيْهِ بَدَنَةٌ وَيُقِيمُ بِمَكَّةَ حَتَّى يَخْرُجَ الشَّهْرُ الَّذِي اعْتَمَرَ فِيهِ ثُمَّ يَخْرُجُ إِلَى الْوَقْتِ الَّذِي وَقَّتَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ لِأَهْلِهِ فَيُحْرِمُ مِنْهُ وَيَعْتَمِرُ.

translations.en: He عليه السلام said: "He has invalidated his ʿUmrah, and upon him is a badanah. He is to remain in Makkah until the month in which he performed the ʿUmrah has passed; then he goes out to the miqat that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم designated for the people of his region, enters into ihram from there, and performs ʿUmrah."

en.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning one performing ʿUmrah Mufradah who has marital relations before completing the saʿy between al-Safa and al-Marwah. The Imam عليه السلام rules that the ʿUmrah is invalidated, a badanah is required as expiation, and the person must later re-enter ihram from the proper miqat and perform a new ʿUmrah.
en.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone has marital relations before completing saʿy in ʿUmrah Mufradah?

key_terms.عُمْرَةً مُفْرَدَةً: an independent ʿUmrah performed separately, not joined to hajj
key_terms.طَوَافَ الْفَرِيضَةِ: the obligatory circumambulation of the Kaʿbah within the rite
key_terms.يَغْشَى امْرَأَتَهُ: has marital relations with his wife
key_terms.الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ: the two sacred points between which saʿy is performed
key_terms.بَدَنَةٌ: a camel offered as expiatory sacrifice
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ: the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family
key_terms.فَيُحْرِمُ: he enters into ihram from the appointed miqat
